about: Home photo windows. order = the order photos come up (a new photo in site/img/slides not listed here comes last). big = photos the large window may show. bigOnly = wide photos that lose people or parts of an aircraft in a small window. notTablet = photos left out on tablets. focus = the part to keep in view when a photo is cropped (left-right, top-bottom). first.txt in site/img/slides must be the first photo of order at 40 px.
